description: Bayerische Erdbebenmessstationen is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. High demands are placed on the locations of earthquake measuring stations (e.g. minimal ground unrest), which is why there are certain restrictions regarding the use of wind energy (minimum levels for wind turbines) in order to largely rule out interference with the extremely sensitive measuring technology. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Bavarian earthquake monitoring stations" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Seismik, Planungsgrundlagen, gdiby, Energie-Atlas Bayern, Bayerischer Erdbebendienst, Windenergie. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
